entities.summary: Ilya Nikolaevich Lyubushkin is a Russian professional ice hockey player who is a defenceman for the Dallas Stars of the National Hockey League (NHL). He previously played for the Arizona Coyotes, Buffalo Sabres, Toronto Maple Leafs, and Anaheim Ducks of the NHL and Lokomotiv Yaroslavl of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL).
